name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Provides direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year to eligible landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per year transferred directly into bank accounts in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 every four months.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names across the country.

Subject to scheme exclusion criteria (such as institutional landholders, individuals who paid income tax in the last assessment year, constitutional post holders, and serving or retired government/PSU employees excluding Group D/multi-tasking staff).
required_information: Landholding documentation or land ownership details
Bank account details linked with Aadhaar
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Offers comprehensive crop insurance covering yield losses due to non-preventable natural risks like drought, flood, pests, and unseasonal rains.
benefits: Insurance coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage.
Uniform low premium rates: maximum 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
Available for both loanee and non-loanee farmers.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
benefits: Cashless and paperless inpatient healthcare cover up to Rs 5 lakh per eligible family per year at empaneled public and private hospitals.
Covers pre-existing conditions, diagnostics, medicines, and post-hospitalization expenses.
eligibility: Families identified under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) deprivation and occupational criteria.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above (Ayushman Vay Vandana card) regardless of income.
required_information: Ration card or family identification document
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Special micro-credit facility providing collateral-free working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors.
benefits: Initial collateral-free working capital loan up to Rs 10,000 with a 1-year tenure.
Higher loan limits up to Rs 20,000 on second tranche and Rs 50,000 on third tranche upon timely repayment.
Interest subsidy of 7% per annum on timely repayments and monthly cashback on digital transactions.
eligibility: Street vendors vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020.
Possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
required_information: Vending Certificate or ID card / Letter of Recommendation from ULB
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides loans up to Rs 20 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises to facilitate business establishment and expansion.
benefits: Collateral-free institutional credit categorized into Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 20 lakh).
Nominal processing charges and affordable interest rates.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income-generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector.
required_information: Identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN card)
Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased and bank statement
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to financial services including banking savings accounts, credit, insurance, and pensions.
benefits: Zero-balance savings bank account with no minimum balance requirements.
Free RuPay debit card with built-in accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh.
Overdraft facility up to Rs 10,000 to eligible account holders.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years and above who does not already hold a bank account.
required_information: Aadhaar card or officially valid document (Voter ID, Driving License, PAN)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
description: Provides clean cooking fuel (LPG connections) to adult women from poor households to safeguard family health from indoor air pollution.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection including a security deposit of cylinder, pressure regulator, LPG hose, domestic gas consumer card, and installation charges.
First LPG refill and hotplate/stove provided free of cost.
eligibility: Adult woman belonging to poor households (SC/ST, PMAY beneficiaries, Antyodaya Anna Yojana, forest dwellers, most backward classes, tea garden tribes, or 14-point declaration).
No other LPG connection in the same household.
required_information: Aadhaar card of the applicant woman and adult family members
Ration card or family composition proof
Bank account number with IFSC code
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit cash incentive program compensating for wage loss and encouraging health-seeking behavior among pregnant women and lactating mothers.
benefits: Cash incentive of Rs 5,000 in two installments for the first living child upon early registration and institutional delivery.
Additional Rs 6,000 in a single installment for the birth of a second child if the child is a girl.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged sections.
Excluded: Regular employees of Central/State Governments or Public Sector Undertakings.
required_information: Aadhaar card of woman beneficiary and husband
Bank account details linked with Aadhaar
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides financial assistance to rural homeless and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
benefits: Unit financial assistance of Rs 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas.
Additional 90 to 95 person-days of unskilled labor support through MGNREGA.
Rs 12,000 assistance for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin.
eligibility: Rural families who are houseless or living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roof as per SECC 2011 and Awaas+ list.
Verified by the local Gram Sabha.
department: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Facilitates pucca housing for all eligible urban households including Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), and Middle Income Group (MIG).
benefits: Central financial assistance up to Rs 1.5 lakh to Rs 2.67 lakh depending on the component (In-situ Slum Redevelopment, Credit Linked Subsidy, Affordable Housing in Partnership, Beneficiary-led Construction).
Interest subsidy on home loans for first-time home buyers.
eligibility: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
EWS annual household income up to Rs 3 lakh; LIG annual income Rs 3 lakh to Rs 6 lakh.
required_information: Aadhaar card of all family members
Income certificate or proof of income
Land ownership documents (for Beneficiary-led Construction component)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
description: Scholarship initiative supporting meritorious students belonging to OBC, EBC, and DNT categories to pursue secondary and higher secondary education.
benefits: Pre-matric scholarship of Rs 4,000 per annum for students studying in Class 9 and 10.
Post-matric scholarship covering academic allowance and tuition fees for higher secondary and collegiate education.
eligibility: Students belonging to OBC, EBC, or DNT categories studying in identified schools/institutions.
Total annual family income must not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh.
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages to complete their education.
benefits: Full reimbursement of non-refundable compulsory fees charged by the recognized educational institution.
Monthly academic maintenance allowance ranging from Rs 2,500 to Rs 13,500 per annum depending on the course group.
eligibility: Students belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community.
Studying in a recognized post-matriculation course.
Annual family income from all sources not exceeding Rs 2.50 lakh.
required_information: Caste certificate issued by competent authority
Admission fee receipt and institutional verification
Active bank account linked with Aadhaar
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum 100 days of paid unskilled manual employment per household per year.
Statutory minimum wage paid directly into bank/post office accounts within 15 days of work completion.
Unemployment allowance payable if work is not provided within 15 days of application.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
Must reside within the local Gram Panchayat area.
required_information: Proof of residence in Gram Panchayat
Bank or Post Office savings account details
department: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Flagship skill certification scheme aimed at enabling youth to take up industry-relevant, market-driven skill training to secure better livelihoods.
benefits: Free short-term skill training, upskilling, and reskilling courses aligned with National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF).
Government-recognized skill certification and placement assistance / apprenticeship support.
Assessment and certification fees fully funded by the government.
eligibility: Indian youth aged 15 to 45 years who are unemployed, school or college dropouts, or seeking formal skill certification.
required_information: Active mobile number and email ID
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension scheme administered by PFRDA primarily focused on workers in the unorganized sector to provide post-retirement financial security.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000, Rs 2,000, Rs 3,000, Rs 4,000, or Rs 5,000 from age 60 until demise based on contributions.
Spouse receives the same pension upon the subscriber's demise, followed by return of corpus to the nominee.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years holding a savings bank account.
Subscriber must not be an income taxpayer (effective October 1, 2022).
required_information: Active savings bank account with auto-debit facility
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: One-year renewable accidental insurance scheme offering high-coverage protection against accidental death and permanent disability at a very low premium.
benefits: Risk coverage of Rs 2,00,000 for accidental death or total permanent disability.
Risk coverage of Rs 1,00,000 for permanent partial disability.
Extremely affordable premium of Rs 20 per annum auto-debited from bank account.
eligibility: Individuals aged between 18 and 70 years with an active savings bank or post office account.
Consent to enable annual auto-debit of the premium.
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Maharashtra state government flagship initiative providing direct monthly financial assistance to women to support self-reliance, nutrition, and health.
benefits: Direct financial assistance of Rs 1,500 per month transferred directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the woman beneficiary.
eligibility: Permanent resident woman of Maharashtra state aged between 21 and 65 years.
Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned, or destitute women.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2.50 lakh.
Family members must not be regular government employees or income tax payers.
required_information: Domicile certificate of Maharashtra (or ration card / school leaving certificate showing 15 years residency)
Income certificate (up to Rs 2.50 lakh) or yellow/orange ration card
department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
description: Maharashtra state government flagship health insurance scheme providing cashless medical and surgical treatment for serious illnesses.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year across empaneled public and private network hospitals.
Covers 1,356 identified medical and surgical procedures across multiple specialties.
eligibility: Residents of Maharashtra holding Yellow, Orange, or Antyodaya Ration Cards.
Farmers from 14 distressed agricultural districts holding white ration cards or 7/12 land extract.
Now universally extended to all Maharashtra families holding valid ration cards and domicile.
required_information: Valid Ration Card (Yellow/Orange/Antyodaya/White with eligibility criteria)
Aadhaar card of patient and family head
Medical diagnosis documents from medical authority
department: State Health Assurance Society, Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
